input: Owner follow-ups 2026-10-16: home page for everything (and why that gap was outstanding), dev process dashboard on GH Pages updated frequently, delivery/CI metrics, shift-left CI direction
task: Hub for everything + self-hosted category; development dashboard (platform/devstats); fix red Portfolio validate (score coverage), sibling-links orphans, catch-all overflow and a missing JSON-LD on main

errors.what: First push broke gitops publish-branch stub, sibling-links and pages tests (apps/CLIs removed from searchable categories)
errors.fixed: stub accepts devstats; apps stay in categories and also get kind sections; orphans closed

doc_friction.issue: --check required a hand-made score for every venture; with ~25 ventures/day it kept Portfolio validate red on main and invited invented numbers. Now reports unscored ventures instead.
'Public face for everything' goal (10-14/15) had no backlog item, metric or check, so 2 days of merges never touched the calculator-framed hub (P013).
5 tests fail on clean main (adopt-stranded-branches.yml runs-on and README counts); not fixed here, noted.

deviations.why: Fixed four pre-existing red checks on main (scoring coverage, sibling orphans, catch-all bound, secondary JSON-LD) inside this PR rather than a separate one, because they blocked this PR's CI and the fixes were small.
deviations.result: local suites green except the 5 pre-existing test_ci_runner failures

notes: Measured with prompts/runcost.py --since the PR1 merge (2026-10-16T00:26:00Z).

pricing.source: Anthropic pricing as cached in the Claude API skill (models table and per-model migration notes), 2026-10-06. Cache writes are 1.25x input (5-minute) and 2x input (1-hour); cache reads differ by model.

human_equivalent.basis: one senior engineer: root-cause the hub framing and the red checks (2h), hub kinds + category + tests (4h), dev dashboard collector/renderer/tests + publish wiring (5h), scoring policy + data fixes (1.5h), CI iteration and mirror regen (1.5h)

certainty.tokens: high: summed from the per-request `usage` the API returned, as the transcript recorded it, deduplicated by message id
certainty.model: high: the `model` field on each API response, not the configured model
certainty.api_equivalent_usd: medium: measured tokens x list prices in prompts/pricing.json (as_of stated); an equivalent, not a charge: these runs are billed under a subscription
certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured

not_counted: requests the harness makes outside the transcript (context compaction summaries, title generation, safety classifiers), if any
transcripts lost when a cloud session moved to a new container: only files present in this container are read, so a resumed session can undercount
server-tool fees (web search is billed per search, not per token); the count is recorded, not priced
CI minutes and the reviewer bots' own model calls
